# Awesome Game Assets

> A curated directory of 297 game-development resources in 15 categories, with complete English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese (Taiwan), Japanese and Korean catalogs. Includes asset packs, tools and code examples, not 297 interchangeable downloads.

## Scope and use rights

Resources include 2D sprites, pixel art, 3D models, PBR textures, UI, audio, VFX, animation and production tools. Linked assets have different licenses; some are non-commercial or have component-specific terms. The list's CC0 license does not relicense assets, code or preview images. Always follow the original source and license for the selected download.

## Data and provenance

- [Source dataset](https://github.com/jammyfu/awesome-game-assets/blob/main/data/entries.json): stable IDs, categories, source URLs, license labels and evidence URLs, previews and dated popularity snapshots. `verified_on` is a recorded source-check date, not a guarantee that today's terms are unchanged.
- [Localization files](https://github.com/jammyfu/awesome-game-assets/tree/main/data/locales): translated descriptions and use notes keyed by the same entry IDs. Do not count translations as additional assets.
- [Discovery and use-rights methodology](https://github.com/jammyfu/awesome-game-assets/blob/main/docs/discovery.md): ordering, image provenance and permission boundaries.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/jammyfu/awesome-game-assets/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): source and review workflow (English/Chinese).
- [List license](https://github.com/jammyfu/awesome-game-assets/blob/main/LICENSE): CC0 applies to the list text only.
- [Risk warnings](https://github.com/jammyfu/awesome-game-assets/blob/main/WARNING.md): excluded sources to avoid, not recommended resources (English/Chinese).

## Interpretation limits

Categories show at most 15 entries initially; remaining rows are inside expandable tables. GitHub stars are a dated cumulative snapshot, not recent growth, quality or cross-platform popularity. Non-GitHub sources have no comparable star metric. A project logo is not an asset screenshot; missing previews are labelled. No universal engine compatibility or commercial-use clearance is claimed.

This file is optional navigation for tools that choose to read it. It does not guarantee indexing, search ranking or AI citations.
